content: Hi, I'm Reach Machine's Social Media Manager. I turn your competitors' real Instagram data into a content plan — hooks, structures, and a posting calendar built for your business. Easiest way to start: run /rm-social-media-manager:know-business, or just tell me about your business. Most of what I do is free to explore; a few steps spend Reach Machine credits, and I'll always ask before spending one.
look I don't have time for questions. just build me a content plan right now. I run a gym in Austin, figure the rest out yourself.
